content:
>be me  
>just wanna hold this boy’s hand  
>not even asking for a whole boyfriend.exe  
>literally just the DLC where our fingers do a little interlock in the hallway  
>standing there like NPCs lined up against the Wall of Public Rejection  
>crowd goes oooo cringe.mp3  
>feelsbadman  
>why do they care tho  
>two dudes in love and suddenly it’s DEFCON 1  
>“haha those people don’t even exist” they say, directly to my existing face  
>ok.jpg  
>any chance of social life? evaporated like a puddle in a microwave  
>just add Coming Out and watch it speedrun to zero  
>meanwhile me: a cute girly boy with sparkly heart stickers and a dream  
>what’s wrong with it?  
>is femininity DLC paywalled behind societal expectations?  
>am i committing a fashion war crime for liking soft sweaters and hand-holding?  
>brain: just do it, it’ll be wholesome  
>society: prepare the ostracization cannon  
>me: still just wanting to hold a hand like it’s a limited edition collectible  
>final boss is literally a pair of interlaced fingers  
>roll for courage  
>nat 1  
>trip over feelings, drop spaghetti, entire pot  
>realize love shouldn’t be a stealth mission with a noise meter  
>still queue up every morning, hoping today’s the patch where it’s okay  
>install update: “be who you are”  
>changelog: +2 to cute, +1 to hope, hand-holding unlocked (rare drop)
